description.en: The number of tasks per page.

description.zh: 任务状态，作为过滤条件使用
description.en: The task state. If specified, the operation returns only tasks in that state.

description.zh: Comfy工作流ID，作为过滤条件使用
description.en: If you specify this parameter, the operation returns only tasks for the specified workflow.

descriptions.zh: > 截图查询目前不支持分页，仅支持按迭代方式。使用返回结果里的extStartTime参数值，作为新请求的StartTime可请求下一页。
descriptions.en: > Querying by screenshot does not support pagination and only supports iteration. To request the next page, use the extStartTime parameter value from the response as the StartTime for the new request.
